description: This file defines the interface and configuration for the Rte module in a microcontroller project, including function prototypes for reading and writing data, and calling external calculator functions, specifically tailored for the MPC5567 microcontroller.

methods.name: Rte_IRead_TesterRunnable_Arguments_arg1
methods.description: Reads the first argument for the Tester Runnable, returning an 8-bit unsigned value.

methods.name: Rte_IRead_TesterRunnable_Arguments_arg2
methods.description: Reads the second argument for the Tester Runnable, returning an 8-bit unsigned value.

methods.name: Rte_IWrite_TesterRunnable_Result_result
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned result value from the Tester Runnable.

methods.name: Rte_Call_Tester_Calculator_Multiply
methods.description: Calls an external calculator function to multiply two 8-bit unsigned integers, returning a 16-bit result.

methods.name: Rte_IRead_FreqReqRunnable_FreqReq_freq
methods.description: Reads the current frequency request value, returning a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: Rte_IWrite_FreqReqRunnable_FreqReqInd_freq
methods.description: Writes a frequency value to indicate a frequency request.

methods.name: TesterRunnable
methods.description: Main function/entry point for the Tester Runnable process.

methods.name: FreqReqRunnable
methods.description: Main function/entry point for the Frequency Request Runnable process.
